title: PHANITERS 2N1 MO (27–28/05/2026)
summary: TODAYOURIST was pleased to accompany 35 teacher of the A-A Tree Minor School on a tour – a pleasure-free and laughter in the beautiful sea city of Phan Tei.

content.text: TODAYOURIST was pleased to accompany 35 teacher of the A-A Tree Minor School on a tour – a pleasure-free and laughter in the beautiful sea city of Phan Tei.
Check in Mango Beach with polar sea space chill
Free to bathe the sea, relax and enjoy cool sea air
Joining the night Gala Dinner was dynamic, attached and many memorable moments
Discovering the White Constance – “The famous Desert of Ping Shun
Check in Wonder Hill with the extreme view between the seaway Phan Iron
Enjoy local food and fascinating marine solidies
Buy Phan Specials as a Gift for Family and Family
TODAYOURIST congratulates the ladies on their continued health, joy, and great fond memories after this journey!
